people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: Asahel
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face?”
translations.bsb: Once again, Abner warned Asahel, “Stop chasing me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How could I show my face to your brother Joab?”
translations.kjv: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?
translations.asv: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?
